name: gantt-timelines
description: Gantt timelines monorepo — Next.js UI + NestJS API
author: Ruchira <rcwbandara@gmail.com>

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @gantt/web" "npm run dev -w @gantt/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @gantt/api && npm run build -w @gantt/web
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run start -w @gantt/web" "npm run start -w @gantt/api"
